build.beforeDevCommand: npm run build:desktop && npx --yes serve -l 1420 desktop-www

security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Configure SiK telemetry radios over USB serial
bundle.longDescription: Desktop app for configuring SiK 900 MHz / 433 MHz telemetry radios via native serial ports on Windows, macOS, and Linux.
